cardText: DEPLOY: Deal 1 damage to ALL characters. (Yes, including your own.)
flavorText: Doesn't discriminate. Everything burns equally. Including himself. Including YOU. The Pyroclast consider this 'fair.'

name: Pyro Bolt
cardText: Deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Point. Click. Incinerate. Three to face for two mana. The Pyroclast designed this spell in committee. The committee was on fire.

name: Lava Lurker
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the minion that killed this.
flavorText: Kill it. Go ahead. It explodes on whatever killed it. The Pyroclast designed it to punish trading. It punishes EVERYTHING.

name: Scorched Fanatic
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: His will is fire. His body is temporary. Three damage to face when he IMMOLATES. The Pyroclast consider him a HERO. He's on fire.

name: Flame Geyser
cardText: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Summon a 2/1 Ember Elemental with IMMOLATE: Deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: Kills something. Leaves a flaming present behind. The present has IMMOLATE. The gift that keeps on burning.

name: Volcanic Shard
cardText: DEPLOY: Deal 3 damage split randomly among all enemies.
flavorText: LAVA shrapnel. Three hits. Random targets. The Pyroclast don't aim. They just ensure everything is within fire range.

name: Fuel the Flames
cardText: Your IMMOLATE effects deal 2 extra damage this turn. Draw a card.
flavorText: More fuel. MORE. MOOORE. Every IMMOLATE this turn hits 2 harder. Plus a card. The Pyroclast's idea of 'support magic' is 'more fire.'

name: Charred Berserker
cardText: SWIFT. IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: 5/1 with SWIFT. It hits for 5 immediately. Dies to a sneeze. IMMOLATES for 2 to everything. The Pyroclast kamikaze lifestyle.

name: Inferno Caller
cardText: DEPLOY: Deal 2 damage to two random enemies.
flavorText: Calls fire. Fire picks up EVERY time. Four damage spread across two targets. The Pyroclast phone network has one ringtone: screaming.

name: Blazing Chariot
cardText: BLITZ. IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Doesn't stop. CAN'T stop. It's ON FIRE. BLITZ means it hits immediately. IMMOLATE means it burns face when it dies. Coming AND going.

name: Wall of Flame
cardText: Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: Some people just want to watch everything burn. The Pyroclast ARE those people. Three to everything. No survivors. No apologies.

name: Eruption
cardText: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Deal 2 damage to all other enemy minions.
flavorText: Target goes down. Everything nearby catches fire. Collateral damage isn't a downside for the Pyroclast. It's the POINT.

name: Magma Giant
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Five tons of angry lava. Three damage to face when it IMMOLATES. The Pyroclast don't build statues. They build THREATS that melt.

name: Pyroclastic Flow
cardText: Deal 4 damage to all enemy minions.
flavorText: No escape. No survivors. No refunds. The Pyroclast don't sell insurance because there's nothing LEFT to insure.

name: Furnace Fiend
cardText: Whenever ANY minion dies, deal 1 damage to the enemy Hero. Gains +1/+0 for each minion that died this game.
flavorText: Feeds on death. Every corpse is fuel. Every funeral is a Pyroclast celebration. It's been counting bodies since Turn 1 and it's ENORMOUS.

name: Rain of Fire
cardText: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Repeat for each friendly minion that died this turn.
flavorText: Three minions died this turn? Three volleys. Everything gets hit three times. The Pyroclast don't mourn the dead. They WEAPONIZE them.

name: Infernal Juggernaut
cardText: SWIFT. IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: HE is the catastrophe. 6/5 SWIFT that hits immediately. IMMOLATES for 3 to everything. The Pyroclast's idea of a 'subtle entrance.'

name: Hellfire Breath
cardText: Deal 5 damage to all characters. (Yes. ALL. Including yours.)
flavorText: Fair? No. Fun? ABSOLUTELY. Five to everything. Your face too. The Pyroclast don't believe in 'friendly fire.' ALL fire is friendly.

name: Ashen Colossus
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal 4 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: When it falls, civilizations end. When it IMMOLATES, four damage hits everything on the other side. The Pyroclast built a 7/7 extinction event.

name: Doomsday Meteor
cardText: Deal 8 damage to a minion and 4 damage to all other enemies.
flavorText: Extinction-level event in card form. The primary target gets obliterated. Everything else burns. The Pyroclast submitted this to peer review. The peers are dead.

name: Kindling
cardText: LAST WORDS: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Born to die. And burn. One mana. Two face damage on death. The Pyroclast's cheapest and most enthusiastic employee.

name: Ash Pit
cardText: Whenever a friendly minion dies, deal 1 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Everything returns to ash. Ash returns to YOUR FACE. Every single death pings face for 1. Seven minions die? Seven damage. The Pit COUNTS.

name: Flamecaller Disciple
cardText: Your IMMOLATE effects deal 2 extra damage.
flavorText: Teacher says always add more fire. PERMANENTLY. Every IMMOLATE on every minion hits 2 harder while she's alive. The Pyroclast's favorite tutor.

name: Volcanic Ritual
cardText: Destroy a friendly minion. Deal damage equal to its Attack to all enemies.
flavorText: Sacrifice accepted. EXPLOSIVELY. Kill your 5/5? Five to everything on the other side. The Pyroclast worship through detonation.

name: Inferno Engine
cardText: Whenever a friendly minion with IMMOLATE dies, summon a 3/2 Flame Elemental with IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: The fire never ends. It just changes SHAPE. IMMOLATE minion dies? A replacement spawns with MORE IMMOLATE. The engine runs on death.

name: Pyromaniac
cardText: Whenever you deal damage to the enemy Hero with a spell or IMMOLATE, gain +1/+1.
flavorText: His hobby is arson. His CAREER is arson. Every face damage makes him bigger. Pyroclast burn spells feed him. He's a 9/10 by Turn 6.

name: Backdraft
cardText: Deal 4 damage to a minion. If it dies, deal 4 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Knock knock. Who's there? FIRE. Kill a minion, burn face for 4. The Pyroclast designed removal that ALSO goes face. Obviously.

name: Living Bomb
cardText: GUARDIAN. IMMOLATE: Deal 4 damage to ALL characters. (Yes. Everyone. Including this.)
flavorText: PLEASE hit me. Actually, PLEASE. It's a 0/5 GUARDIAN that explodes for 4 to EVERYTHING when triggered. The Pyroclast's politest weapon.

name: Cinder Storm
cardText: Deal 8 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavorText: Eight fireballs enter. Random targets. Nobody leaves unburnt. The Pyroclast don't aim. They trust the chaos.

name: Forge of Ignaros
cardText: Start of Turn: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. Your IMMOLATE effects also deal their damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: It forges swords out of hatred. And fire. Two passive face damage per turn AND all IMMOLATE redirected to face. The Pyroclast's holiest furnace.

name: Kamikaze Construct
cardText: BLITZ. IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: First mission. Last mission. SAME mission. 7/1 BLITZ hits for 7 immediately. Dies to a breeze. IMMOLATES for 3 to everything. WORTH IT.

name: Smoldering Remains
cardText: Summon all friendly minions with IMMOLATE that died this turn. They die again at end of turn. (IMMOLATE triggers again.)
flavorText: They come back. Briefly. VIOLENTLY. Die, come back, die AGAIN. Double IMMOLATE triggers. The Pyroclast invented the encore of DEATH.

name: Firestorm Drake
cardText: SWIFT. DEPLOY: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, deal excess damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Breathes fire. Eats fire. IS fire. Overkill damage GOES TO FACE. Kill a 1-health minion? 2 to face. The Pyroclast's favorite math.

name: Volcanic Heart
cardText: Give a minion IMMOLATE: Deal damage equal to this minion's Attack to all enemies.
flavorText: Strap a bomb onto ANYTHING. Your 7/7 now IMMOLATES for 7 to everything. The Pyroclast don't buff stats. They buff EXPLOSIONS.

name: Emberstrike Assassin
cardText: CLOAK. IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: You won't see it coming. You WILL feel it burning. 4/1 invisible. Decloaks. Hits for 4. Dies. IMMOLATES for 3 to face. SEVEN total.

name: Molten Armor
cardText: Give a minion +2/+3 and IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to the minion that killed this.
flavorText: WARNING: Do NOT hug the wearer. Stats AND a revenge bomb. Kill the minion and the killer takes 3. The Pyroclast idea of 'armor.'

name: Infernal Pact
cardText: Whenever you deal damage to the enemy Hero on your turn, deal 1 additional damage. (Stacks with each instance.)
flavorText: Sign here. In fire. WITH fire. Every face hit adds +1. Three separate face damage events? Three EXTRA damage. The Pyroclast's contract has ONE clause: MORE.

name: Scorchborn Twins
cardText: DEPLOY: Summon a 3/2 copy with IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Two for one. Both on fire. Both IMMOLATE for 2 to face. Kill one? Two damage. Kill both? FOUR damage. Leave them alive? They hit for 6. The Pyroclast LOVE twins.

name: Burnout
cardText: Deal damage to the enemy Hero equal to the number of friendly minions that died this game. (Max 10.)
flavorText: Every dead minion counted. Every sacrifice tallied. Turn 8 after ten deaths? TEN to face for THREE mana. The Pyroclast keep a body count. It becomes a FIREBALL.

name: Flashfire
cardText: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. If you dealt damage to the enemy Hero already this turn, deal 4 instead.
flavorText: First burn of the turn? Two damage. SECOND burn? FOUR. The Pyroclast reward momentum. Burn once, burn HARDER.

name: Magma Rebirth
cardText: Destroy a friendly Elemental. Summon a random Elemental that costs (2) more from your deck. Give it IMMOLATE: Deal 3 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Kill a 2-drop. Get a 4-drop. WITH IMMOLATE. Pyroclast evolution: sacrifice the small fire. Get a BIGGER fire.

name: Pyroclast Warchief
cardText: Your minions with IMMOLATE have +2 Attack. Whenever a friendly minion IMMOLATES, deal 1 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Buffs every bomb. Pings face every time one goes off. The Pyroclast's field commander. His orders: BURN LOUDER.

name: CHAIN DETONATION
cardText: Destroy a friendly minion. Trigger its IMMOLATE. Then trigger the IMMOLATE of every other friendly minion with IMMOLATE.
flavorText: Kill one bomb. It explodes. Every other bomb on your board ALSO explodes. Four IMMOLATE minions? One sacrifice triggers FIVE explosions. The Pyroclast invented the chain reaction and they are NOT sorry. Three mana. Total board detonation.

name: LIVING INFERNO
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal damage to all enemies equal to the total IMMOLATE damage you've dealt this game. (Max 8.)
flavorText: It remembers every burn. Every IMMOLATE trigger this entire game. Dealt 6 IMMOLATE damage so far? It IMMOLATES for 6 to everything. The fire has a MEMORY and the memory is ANGRY. The Pyroclast's angriest creation.

name: SUPERNOVA
cardText: Destroy ALL minions. Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero for each minion destroyed. Trigger all friendly IMMOLATE effects first.
flavorText: Everything dies. But YOUR minions IMMOLATE first, dealing their death damage. Then every destroyed minion deals 2 to face. Seven minions total? All IMMOLATES fire, then FOURTEEN to face. The Pyroclast's nuclear option. There is no board anymore. There is only FIRE.

name: PYROCLAST AVATAR
cardText: DEPLOY: Give ALL friendly minions IMMOLATE: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. IMMOLATE: Deal 4 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Everything on your board is now a bomb. Your 1/1 tokens? Bombs. Your GUARDIAN? A bomb. ALL of them IMMOLATE for 2 to face. The Avatar itself hits for 4. The Pyroclast don't arm soldiers. They arm EVERYONE.

name: DOOMFIRE SENTINEL
cardText: BLITZ. Whenever this attacks and kills a minion, deal its Attack as damage to the enemy Hero. IMMOLATE: Deal damage to all enemies equal to the number of minions that died this game.
flavorText: Kills a 5/5? Five to face. IMMOLATE scales with every death this game. Ten minions died? IMMOLATES for TEN. The Pyroclast's executioner doesn't just kill — he sends the BILL to your opponent's face.

name: PHOENIX ETERNUS
cardText: BARRIER. LAST WORDS: Deal 3 damage to all enemies. Return this to your hand. It costs (2) less.
flavorText: Death is not the end. It's the WARMUP. Kill it. Three to everything. It comes back CHEAPER. Kill it again. Three MORE to everything. Even cheaper. The Pyroclast's immortal bird has died nine times. It's gotten BETTER at it.

name: ASHYR, THE WORLD BURNER
cardText: DEPLOY: Deal 3 damage to all enemies. IMMOLATE: Deal 5 damage to all enemies. End of Turn: Deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: The Pyroclast had one rule: burn everything. Ashyr added a second: burn it AGAIN. Three damage on entry. Five on IMMOLATE. Two to face every turn. She doesn't stop burning. She CAN'T stop burning. She IS burning.

name: MAGMA TYRANT
cardText: IMMOLATE: Deal 5 damage to all enemies. Your other IMMOLATE effects trigger twice.
flavorText: He doesn't erupt. He DECIDES to erupt. Five to everything when he IMMOLATES. And every OTHER IMMOLATE on your board fires TWICE. Two Ember Imps die? Four triggers instead of two. The Tyrant doubles the apocalypse.

name: GRAND INCINERATOR VOLK
cardText: DEPLOY: For the rest of the game, whenever a friendly minion dies, deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. Your IMMOLATE effects deal double damage.
flavorText: The Pyroclast's high priest. His sermon: every death is 2 to face. PERMANENTLY. And all IMMOLATE damage? DOUBLED. Ember Imp's 1 damage? Now 2. Scorched Fanatic's 3? Now SIX. He turned the entire faction into a face-damage MACHINE.

name: THE FINAL ERUPTION
cardText: Deal 5 damage to ALL characters. Then deal 5 MORE to all characters. Then deal 5 MORE to all characters. (Three waves. 15 total to everything.)
flavorText: Three waves. Fifteen damage. To EVERYTHING. Your face too. Their face too. Every minion on both sides: DEAD. The Pyroclast's final argument is not a debate. It's a VOLCANO. Three eruptions. One card. Zero survivors.

name: Voidborn Wisp
cardText: DEPLOY: Look at the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck. BANISH one.
flavorText: Tiny. Hungry. It peers into your future and EATS the part it doesn't like. The Voidborn start deleting reality before Turn 2.

name: Null Shard
cardText: Deal 1 damage. The target's owner discards a random card.
flavorText: Small cut. Big loss. One damage to the body. One card to the abyss. The Voidborn exchange rate is BRUTAL.

name: Shadow Feeder
cardText: Gains +1/+1 whenever your opponent loses a card from any zone.
flavorText: Your opponent's loss is literally its LUNCH. Discards, BANISHes, deck burns — every lost card is a meal. Feed it often.

name: Entropic Touch
cardText: A random card in your opponent's hand costs (2) more. Draw a card.
flavorText: Everything costs more near the Voidborn. Their 5-drop is now a 7-drop. Their plan just got TWO turns slower. You got a card. Fair.

name: Whispers of Nothing
cardText: Your opponent's highest-cost card costs (3) more this turn.
flavorText: The Void whispers. Their wallet SCREAMS. That finisher they've been holding? Delayed. Possibly forever.

name: Voidborn Stalker
cardText: CLOAK.
flavorText: You can't see it. That's the POINT. It's 3/2 of invisible void energy. It's already behind you. The Voidborn don't announce themselves.

name: Mind Fracture
cardText: Your opponent discards the highest-cost card in their hand.
flavorText: Their best card. Gone. FOREVER. The Voidborn don't negotiate. They don't warn. They TAKE.

name: Rift Crawler
cardText: DEPLOY: Your opponent's next card costs (2) more.
flavorText: Crawls between dimensions. Taxes your opponent's economy on arrival. The Voidborn IRS doesn't file extensions.

name: Void Drain
cardText: Deal 2 damage. BANISH the target if it dies. (BANISHed cards can't be resummoned or returned.)
flavorText: Not just dead. ERASED. No graveyard. No resurrection. No memory. The Voidborn definition of 'permanent.'

name: Entropy Agent
cardText: DEPLOY: Your opponent reveals their entire hand.
flavorText: Knowledge is power. THEIR knowledge is YOUR power. He sees every card. He tells you EVERYTHING. Voidborn intelligence is thorough.

name: Abyssal Lurker
cardText: After your opponent plays a card, gain +1 Attack.
flavorText: Watches. Waits. Grows. Every card your opponent plays makes it angrier. By Turn 8 it's a 10/4. Patience is a Voidborn virtue.

name: Thought Shredder
cardText: DEPLOY: Your opponent discards a random card. Draw a card.
flavorText: They lose one. You GAIN one. Net swing: two cards. The Voidborn call this 'balanced trade.' Nobody agrees.

name: Nullify
cardText: BANISH an enemy minion with 3 or less Attack.
flavorText: It was never here. Check the records. There ARE no records. The Voidborn are very thorough with their un-filing.

name: Void Tendril
cardText: GUARDIAN. LAST WORDS: Your opponent's next TWO cards cost (2) more.
flavorText: Even in death it's insufferable. Kill it and your next two plays cost more. Leave it alive and nothing gets through. The Voidborn designed this SPECIFICALLY to be annoying.

name: Creeping Dread
cardText: All cards in your opponent's hand cost (1) more until your next turn. Draw a card.
flavorText: That sinking feeling? It's real. And it costs extra. Their ENTIRE hand just got taxed. The Voidborn invented inflation.

name: Hollow Shade
cardText: SWIFT.
flavorText: Fast. Empty. Terrifying. It used to be something. The Voidborn hollowed it out and gave it SWIFT. Somehow that's WORSE.

name: Reality Ripper
cardText: DEPLOY: BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Rips cards out of EXISTENCE. Not their hand. Not the discard. EXISTENCE. The Voidborn don't remove things. They un-MAKE them.

name: Void Sentinel
cardText: GUARDIAN. Your opponent's cards cost (1) more.
flavorText: The toll booth at the end of reality. Everything costs extra while it breathes. The Voidborn's favorite passive-aggressive tax collector.

name: Dimensional Rift
cardText: BANISH an enemy minion. Your opponent draws a card.
flavorText: Gone forever. But they get a consolation card. The Voidborn are cruel but POLITE. One card for your loss. You're still losing.

name: Psychic Assault
cardText: Deal damage to the enemy Hero equal to the number of cards they've lost this game. (Max 10.)
flavorText: Every erased card leaves a scar. BANISHed five? Five to the face. The Voidborn keep receipts and the BILL arrives violently.

name: Abyssal Maw
cardText: DEPLOY: BANISH a random card from your opponent's deck.
flavorText: It eats futures. Your opponent will NEVER know what they lost. The Voidborn's cruelest trick: you mourn what you never had.

name: Null Field
cardText: Silence all enemy minions. (Remove all keywords and card text.)
flavorText: Shh. No powers. Only Void now. GUARDIAN? Gone. LETHAL? Gone. Hope? The Voidborn ate that first.

name: Void Harvester
cardText: Whenever your opponent loses a card from any zone, gain +2/+2.
flavorText: Your despair is its protein shake. Discards, BANISHes, deck burns — it's been bulking since Turn 1 and it's ENORMOUS.

name: Erasure
cardText: BANISH an enemy minion.
flavorText: Ctrl+Z doesn't work in the Void. There is no undo. There is only GONE. The Voidborn removed the undo button first.

name: Null Leviathan
cardText: Your opponent's cards cost (1) more. Costs (1) less for each card BANISHed this game.
flavorText: Grows cheaper as reality gets thinner. BANISHed five cards? It costs ONE. The Voidborn reward commitment to deletion.

name: Annihilate
cardText: BANISH all enemy minions with 4 or less Attack.
flavorText: Below the threshold? Below EXISTENCE. The Voidborn set a minimum requirement for existing and enforced it.

name: Oblivion Wraith
cardText: DEPLOY: BANISH all spells from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Doesn't destroy your plans. UN-EXISTS them. Every spell in hand: vanished. The Voidborn consider this 'decluttering.'

name: Consume Reality
cardText: BANISH the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. Draw 2 cards.
flavorText: Five futures. Deleted. They'll never know what they lost. The Voidborn ate their tomorrow and you drew two cards from the crumbs.

name: Void Parasite
cardText: LAST WORDS: BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Tiny. Existentially threatening. Kill it and lose a card. Leave it alive and it stares at you. With ALL its eye. The Voidborn's cutest atrocity.

name: Null Anchor
cardText: Your opponent's first card each turn costs (2) more.
flavorText: Going first each turn never felt so expensive. Their Turn 4 play costs 6. EVERY turn. The Voidborn anchored reality shut.

name: Entropy Weaver
cardText: Whenever a card is BANISHed, draw a card.
flavorText: Destruction IS productive — if you're Voidborn. Every card erased from existence is a card drawn for you. The Voidborn invented recycling.

name: Void Mirror
cardText: DEPLOY: Copy a card from your opponent's hand. It costs (0). Then BANISH the original.
flavorText: Copies it. DELETES the original. You get the card. They LOSE the card. The Voidborn version of 'sharing': take everything, give nothing.

name: Mindbreaker
cardText: DEPLOY: Your opponent discards their highest-cost AND lowest-cost cards.
flavorText: Targets the extremes. Their bomb AND their cheap answer — both gone. The Voidborn cull from both ends of the menu.

name: Voidborn Gate
cardText: Whenever you BANISH a card, deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: Every erasure echoes. BANISH a card? Two to the face. Three BANISHes in one turn? Six damage. Deletion has physical consequences.

name: Black Hole
cardText: BANISH an enemy minion. BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Two-for-one deletion special. Board AND hand — both diminished. The Voidborn are running a clearance sale on existence.

name: Void Siphon
cardText: Steal 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. They cost (1) less.
flavorText: Finders keepers. Losers literally LOSE. Two gone from them. Two gained by you. Four-card swing. Voidborn economics.

name: Abyss Walker
cardText: PHASE. Whenever this attacks, BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Untargetable. Attacks freely. Every swing erases a card from existence. The Voidborn's favorite employee: can't be fired, can't be FOUND.

name: Reality Unraveler
cardText: End of Turn: BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand.
flavorText: Every turn, one card vanishes. They go to sleep with six. Wake up with five. Then four. The Voidborn unravel things slowly.

name: Devour Thoughts
cardText: Your opponent discards 2 random cards. For each spell discarded, draw a card.
flavorText: Two thoughts eaten. If either was a spell? Bonus draw. The Voidborn consider brains an all-you-can-eat buffet.

name: Dimensional Exile
cardText: BANISH all enemy minions with 5 or more Attack.
flavorText: Too powerful to exist? Then DON'T. The Voidborn set a ceiling on power and it's LOW.

name: Void Echo
cardText: ECHO. DEPLOY: BANISH a random card from your opponent's deck.
flavorText: Plays twice. Deletes twice. Smiles twice. Two futures erased that they'll never even see. Preventative Voidborn deletion.

name: Null Assassin
cardText: CLOAK. DEPLOY: BANISH a random card from your opponent's deck.
flavorText: Invisible. Arrives. Deletes a card from their future. The Voidborn's subtlest operative. You won't see him. You won't see what he stole.

name: Entropic Cascade
cardText: Whenever your opponent draws a card, it costs (1) more. Whenever your opponent discards, you draw a card.
flavorText: Their draws cost more. Their losses fuel YOUR draws. Every turn the entropy increases. The Voidborn built a one-way valve on the universe.

name: Existential Crisis
cardText: Silence an enemy minion. BANISH a random card from their hand. Draw a card.
flavorText: Strip their powers. Delete a card. Draw one yourself. Three things for four mana. The Voidborn call this 'light existential therapy.'

name: Void Resonance
cardText: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions. Deal 1 extra for each card BANISHed this game.
flavorText: The more you've erased, the harder this hits. BANISHed 5 cards? 8 damage AoE. The Voidborn remember what they ate.

name: Oblivion Seed
cardText: LAST WORDS: BANISH the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. If any were minions, summon a 2/2 Void Shade.
flavorText: Plant it. Let it die. Three cards erased. Ghosts hatch from the ashes. The Voidborn garden grows DOWNWARD into nothing.

name: Thought Leech
cardText: Whenever your opponent plays a spell, add a copy to your hand. It costs (1) less.
flavorText: Sits. Listens. Copies every spell they cast — cheaper. It's not stealing. It's aggressive Voidborn LEARNING.

name: Mana Collapse
cardText: Your opponent loses 2 Crystals next turn. Draw a card.
flavorText: Their Turn 7? Now it's Turn 5 again. Two crystals ripped away. The Voidborn don't just tax — they REGRESS your timeline.

name: Fade to Black
cardText: Give a friendly Void minion PHASE and +2/+2. BANISH a random card from your opponent's deck.
flavorText: Your creature goes invisible AND grows. Their future loses a card. Two problems created in one spell. Voidborn efficiency.

name: Void Collector
cardText: DEPLOY: Discover a card that was BANISHed this game. Add it to YOUR hand. It costs (0).
flavorText: What the Void takes, the Collector finds. That Legendary they lost? YOURS now. FREE. The Voidborn don't waste what they delete.

name: ENTROPY BOMB
cardText: BANISH a random card from your opponent's hand. Deal 1 damage to the enemy Hero for each card they've lost this game.
flavorText: Two mana. One card erased. And a damage nuke that scales with EVERY card they've already lost. Turn 6 after a few deletions? 2-mana BANISH + 6 to face. The Voidborn built a bomb fueled by absence. The less your opponent HAS, the more it HURTS.

name: THE HOLLOWING
cardText: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent draws a card, BANISH the top card of their deck.
flavorText: Every draw costs them TWO cards. They draw one, they LOSE one. Thirty-card deck? Now it's fifteen. The Voidborn installed a leak in reality and the drip never stops. Their game just got a TIMER.

name: NULL COLOSSUS
cardText: GUARDIAN. Has +1/+1 for each card BANISHed this game. Your opponent's cards cost (1) more.
flavorText: BANISHed 6 cards? It's a 10/14 GUARDIAN with a passive tax aura. The more reality you've eaten, the bigger the wall. The Voidborn built their fortress out of things that no longer exist.

name: MIND DEVOURER
cardText: DEPLOY: Look at your opponent's hand. BANISH 2 cards of YOUR choice. Add Void copies to YOUR hand that cost (0).
flavorText: Sees everything. Picks the two BEST cards. Deletes them. Gives YOU free copies. Their bomb is YOUR bomb. Their answer is YOUR answer. The Mind Devourer doesn't eat random thoughts. It has a MENU.

name: OBLIVION SPHERE
cardText: BANISH all minions on both sides. For each enemy minion BANISHed, deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero. For each friendly minion BANISHed, draw a card.
flavorText: Both boards gone. But THEIR losses deal face damage and YOUR losses draw cards. Full enemy board? Ten to face. Full your board? Seven cards drawn. The Sphere doesn't play favorites. It plays VOID.

name: PROPHET OF THE ENDLESS VOID
cardText: DEPLOY: BANISH your opponent's entire hand. They draw 3. PHASE. End of Turn: Your opponent's cards cost (2) more next turn.
flavorText: He preaches one gospel: nothingness. Their hand? Erased. They draw three. Those three cost two more each. He can't be targeted. The Voidborn's high priest doesn't convert you. He SUBTRACTS you.

name: NULLHEIM'S LAST WORD
cardText: DEPLOY: For the rest of the game, whenever your opponent draws a card, BANISH a random card from their deck. Your BANISH effects also deal 2 damage to the enemy Hero.
flavorText: The Voidborn don't end things. They make things NEVER HAVE BEEN. Every draw your opponent makes deletes something else. Every BANISH burns face. Their deck dissolves. Their health dissolves. Existence dissolves.

name: THE VOID TYRANT
cardText: After your opponent plays a card, BANISH a random card from their hand. Gains +1/+1 for each card BANISHed this game.
flavorText: Every action they take costs them something they haven't lost YET. Play a card? Lose a card. Fight back? Lose MORE. The Tyrant doesn't punish mistakes. It punishes PLAYING THE GAME.

name: ARCHIVIST OF NOTHING
cardText: DEPLOY: For the rest of the game, you may look at your opponent's hand at any time. Whenever a card is BANISHed, add a 0-cost Void copy to your hand.
flavorText: She catalogs everything the Void eats. Then USES it. BANISH a card? Free copy for you. Permanent hand vision. She knows what they have. She HAS what they DON'T. The Voidborn's librarian. The scariest librarian in the galaxy.

name: THE FINAL NOTHING
cardText: BANISH ALL cards in your opponent's hand, the top 10 cards of their deck, and all enemy minions. Deal 1 damage to the enemy Hero for each card BANISHed. Draw 5 cards.
flavorText: Hand: gone. Board: gone. Deck: gutted. Health: burning. Five cards drawn. The Voidborn stopped whispering and SCREAMED. One spell. Everything deleted. The universe sent an invoice for every card ever lost and your opponent just PAID.
